# Gevurah — Native Architecture Boundaries

The Awtsmoos is without limit, yet every useful keli guards one role and line;
Awtsmoos.com gains infinite expansion when finite module boundaries stay fine.

## High-leverage first tranche

1. Add a shared data-driven DOM factory beneath `shared/social/ui/`.
2. Rewrite `ProgressiveDisclosure.js` as a documented class-backed facade while preserving exported functions.
3. Rewrite `ActionOverflow.js` to use explicit policy/state/view helpers and preserve public exports.
4. Rewrite `UniversalActionRail.js` around a small action-control view and explicit async error state.
5. Audit their CSS modules for owned-root scoping, hover/focus/active/disabled/reduced-motion coverage, overflow, and z layers.
6. Only after shared primitives stabilize, add a Social Hub capability-center plugin using real route IDs.

## Non-negotiable contracts

- No `innerHTML`.
- No global element selectors in new/touched social styles.
- No `100vw` in component styles.
- No arbitrary z-index escalation.
- No new mutation authority inside discovery components.
- No route IDs invented outside `RouteModel`.
- Existing exported factory names remain callable.
- Complete-file rewrites only.
